title: Reei's Easy NPCs
description: This Mod Adds Easy Controlled NPCs
body:
![I](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b0910804ead01701d8a5c1f4744dcc76b51d1c82_0.webp)

Reei's EasyNPCs

Reei's EasyNPCs is a simple and useful Minecraft NPC mod that allows players to create, customize and manage NPCs with different classes, poses, dialogues, skins, inventories and movement settings.

This mod is designed to make NPC creation easier for roleplay servers, city maps, economy systems, shops, police systems and custom adventure maps.

Features
Custom NPC classes
Customizable NPC poses
Dialogue system
Skin customization
Inventory system
Special inventory settings
NPC movement system
Movement type settings
Spawn time settings
Class customization
Market worker support with shelves and cash register
New useful NPC tools and items
Added Classes

The mod includes several NPC classes that can be used for different gameplay purposes:

Miner
Mafia
Fisher
Trader
Thief
Market Worker
Banker

Each class can be used to create different types of NPCs for cities, roleplay servers, markets, jobs and custom maps.

New Items

This mod also adds new items to help you control and customize NPCs more easily:

Class Wand
Used to manage or change NPC classes.
Price Wand
Useful for setting prices and market-related interactions.
Movement Wand
Used to configure NPC movement behavior.
Shelves
Designed for market workers and shop systems.
Cash Register
A useful block for market worker setups and shop areas.
Police Badge
A special item that can be used for police or roleplay systems.
NPC Customization

NPCs can be customized with different:

Classes
Dialogues
Skins
Poses
Inventories
Movement types
Spawn time settings

This gives map creators and server owners more control over how NPCs behave and appear in the world.

Perfect For
Roleplay servers
City maps
Economy servers
Shop systems
Police roleplay
Adventure maps
Custom NPC-based gameplay
